camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeActiveOperationTasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status='-1' --AllowCancel='-1' --PageSize 25 --PageNumber 1 --AllowChange='-1' --TaskType rds_apsaradb_upgrade --Region 'cn-beijing' --ProductId RDS --InsName 'rm-bp191w771kd30000' --DbType all --ChangeLevel all
description_en: Queries the details of scheduled O&M tasks for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查看RDS实例的计划内运维任务详情
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-active-operation-tasks --biz-region cn-beijing --task-type rds_apsaradb_upgrade --page-size 25 --page-number 1 --product-id RDS --db-type all --status='-1' --ins-name rm-bp191w771kd30000 --allow-change='-1' --allow-cancel='-1' --change-level all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the pending event. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.
Set this parameter to all to specify all region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
待处理事件所属的地域ID，可调用DescribeRegions接口获取。
取值为all表示所有地域ID
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: primary/secondary node switch.
rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration.
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: minor engine version update.
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: proxy minor version upgrade.
all: all task types
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，取值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主从节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级。
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: 代理小版本升级。
all：所有任务类型
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 25. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数, 默认每页25条，最大100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The product name. Valid values: RDS, POLARDB, MongoDB, and Redis. For ApsaraDB RDS instances, set this parameter to RDS
parameters.help_zh: 产品名称, RDS/POLARDB/MongoDB/Redis，对于RDS实例可选RDS
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The database type. Default value: all. Valid values: mysql, pgsql, and mssql
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，默认为 all
可选：mysql/pgsql/mssql 等
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The task status. This parameter is used to filter the returned tasks. Valid values:
-1: all tasks.
3: pending tasks.
4: in-progress tasks.
5: succeeded tasks.
6: failed tasks.
7: canceled tasks
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，用于筛选返回任务。
-1：全部任务。
3：待处理任务。
4：处理中任务。
5：成功结束任务。
6：失败结束任务。
7：已取消任务
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance name. This parameter is optional. You can specify at most one instance name
parameters.help_zh: 实例名，可不填，填写时只允许填写至多一个实例名
parameters.name: ins_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the task time can be modified. Default value: -1. Valid values:
-1: all tasks.
0: Only tasks whose time cannot be modified are returned.
1: Only tasks whose time can be modified are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许修改时间，默认-1，取值：
-1：全部。
0：只返回不允许修改时间的任务。
1：只返回允许修改时间的任务
parameters.name: allow_change

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the task can be canceled. Default value: -1. Valid values:

-1: all tasks.
0: Only tasks that cannot be canceled are returned.
1: Only tasks that can be canceled are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许取消，默认-1，取值：

-1：全部。
0：只返回不允许取消的任务。
1：只返回允许取消的任务
parameters.name: allow_cancel

parameters.help_en:
The task level. Default value: all. Valid values:

all: all levels.
S0: Only tasks at the exception recovery level are returned.
S1: Only tasks at the system O&M level are returned
parameters.help_zh:
任务级别，默认为 all，取值：

all：全部
S0：返回异常修复级别的任务。
S1：返回系统运维级别的任务
parameters.name: change_level

items.description_en: The details of the O&M task

AllowCancel.description_en: Indicates whether the task can be canceled. A value of 1 indicates that the task can be canceled. A value of 0 indicates that the task cannot be canceled
AllowCancel.description_zh: 是否允许取消，1表示允许用户取消任务，0表示不允许取消

AllowChange.description_en: Indicates whether the task time can be modified. A value of 1 indicates that the time can be modified. A value of 0 indicates that the time cannot be modified
AllowChange.description_zh: 是否允许修改时间，1表示允许用户修改时间，0表示不允许用户修改时间

ChangeLevel.description_en: The event level code. S1 indicates system O&M. S0 indicates risk recovery
ChangeLevel.description_zh: 事件等级代码，S1 系统运维 S0 风险修复

CreatedTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is in UTC and follows the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建时间，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

DbType.description_en: The database type, such as mysql, pgsql, or mssql

Deadline.description_en: The latest deadline by which the task execution time can be adjusted. The time is in UTC and follows the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
Deadline.description_zh: 任务执行时间可调整范围的最晚期限，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

InsComment.description_en: The instance alias or instance description

ModifiedTime.description_en: The modification time. The time is in UTC and follows the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改时间，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

PrepareInterval.description_en: The preparation time required between the start time and the switchover time. The format is HH:mm:ss
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 开始时间到切换时间之间所需的准备时间, 格式为HH:mm:ss

Region.description_en: The region ID of the pending event
Region.description_zh: 待处理事件所属的地域ID

StartTime.description_en: The time when the backend executes the task. The time is in UTC and follows the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
StartTime.description_zh: 后台执行任务的时间点，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
3: pending.
4: in progress.
5: succeeded.
6: failed.
7: canceled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。
3：待处理任务。
4：处理中任务。
5：成功结束任务。
6：失败结束任务。
7：已取消任务

SwitchTime.description_en: The time when the backend initiates the switchover. The time is in UTC and follows the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
SwitchTime.description_zh: 后台发起切换操作的时间点，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: primary/secondary node switch.
rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration.
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: minor engine version update.
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: proxy minor version upgrade
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型，取值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主从节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级。
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: 代理小版本升级

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 25. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数, 默认每页25条，最大100

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of task records returned
